system.summary: Numerical homophonic alphabets (1-2 digit values, up to 5 homophones) with a nomenclator of 3-digit numbers, or letter+digit groups in the Jan 1646 key; four key periods per Lasry.
system.sibling_key: Same series as DECODE R752, R788, R789, R925, R928 (all read by Lasry)
system.notes: Four keys: TNA SP 106, SP106-2, SP106-5, SP106-8.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Fetched the six DECODE record pages with the shared cookie; each links Lasry's reconstructed key and plaintext (2020-10-23) for the whole ff. 207-247 run.
Applied Lasry's SP106-5 alphabet to Pettersson's raw transcription of f. 247 (R929); reads English matching his plaintext.

outcome.method_basis: Lasry's reconstructed keys and plaintexts (2020-10-23) are attached to the DECODE records for ff. 207-247; applying his SP106-5 alphabet to Pettersson's transcription of f. 247 (R929) reproduced his reading.
outcome.notes: Nothing new; nomenclator numbers remain open in Lasry's plaintexts. Catalogue entries 54, 55, 59, 60 resolved.
